ALL that certain lot, piece or parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon erected, situate,  
lying and being in the Borough of Haddonfield, in the County of Camden, State of New Jersey:

Tract #1

Beginning in the Northwesterly line of Euclid Avenue 80 feet Southwestwardly from the Westerly corner of  
Euclid and Turnley Avenues; thence Southwestwardly along the Northwesterly line of Euclid Avenue 80  
feet in width or breadth; thence Northwestwardly between parallel lines, parallel with Turnley Avenue 142  
feet in length or depth.

Tract #2

Beginning at a point in the boundary line of premises owned by the party of the first part which beginning  
point is located on the Northerly line of Euclid Avenue, distant 160 feet Westwardly along said line from its  
intersection with the Westerly line of Turnley Avenue; and extends thence

1.  Westwardly along said Northerly line of Euclid Avenue the distance of 10 feet to a point; and extends  
    thence

2.  Northwardly parallel with the Westerly line of Turnley Avenue making an interior angle of 89 degrees,  
    43 minutes 30 seconds with the preceding course the distance of 142 feet to a point; and extends thence

3.  Eastwardly parallel with the first course the distance of 10 feet to an angle in the boundary line of  
    property of the party of the first part; and extends thence

4.  Southwardly parallel with the second course along party of the first part’s said boundary line the  
    distance of 142 feet to the point of beginning.

FOR INFORMATION PURPOSES ONLY:  BEING known as 15 East Euclid Avenue, Tax Lot 3.01, Tax Block 129 on the Official Tax Map of Borough of Haddonfield, New Jersey.
